abstract: Clonal lines of embryonal carcinoma cells have been established in culture from four independently-derived transplantable teratocarcinomas of mice: three from strain C3H and one from strain 129/Sv. Cells from all lines retain the capacity to differentiate into a variety of tissue types both in tumors formed following the injection of cells into syngeneic animals and in vitro under appropriate culture conditions. Analysis of their G-banded chromosomes indicated that the four lines have near-diploid but not absolutely normal karyotypes. The same chromosomal abnormalities were often present in more than one line. Tetraploid embryonal carcinoma cells made by Colcemid or cytochalasin B treatment were also pluripotential in spite of chromosomal instability. Hybrid cells were readily obtained between diploid or tetraploid embryonal carcinoma cells and mouse 3T3 fibroblasts. Hybrid cells failed to differentiate and were contact inhibited like the 3T3 parent.
abstract_ja: 移植可能なマウス奇形癌4系統（C3H系3系統、129/Sv系1系統）由来の胎児性癌細胞のクローン株を培養系で樹立した。各株は、同系動物に移植して形成された腫瘍内でも、適切な培養条件下のin vitroでも、多様な組織型へ分化する能力を保持していた。G分染による染色体解析では、4株ともほぼ二倍体であるが完全には正常でない核型を示した。同一の染色体異常が複数の株で見られることがしばしばあった。コルセミドまたはサイトカラシンB処理により作製した四倍体の胎児性癌細胞も、染色体不安定性にもかかわらず多能性を保持していた。二倍体または四倍体の胎児性癌細胞とマウス3T3線維芽細胞との雑種細胞は容易に得られた。雑種細胞は分化せず、親株の3T3と同様に接触阻止を示した。
